source_text: Our onboarding emails are ignored and churn is climbing, so we are rebuilding the whole first week for new clients.
reply: Most of our early churn came from clients who never finished onboarding in their first 14 days, so the first week is the right place to start.

source_text: Is fixed pricing worth it for agencies?
reply: Seen this from the other side. We moved 12 client projects from hourly billing to fixed-scope pricing, and invoice disputes dropped to zero that quarter.

source_text: How do you hire without CVs?
reply: Two of our best hires had weak CVs. The paid one-week trial told us more than any interview.
